annotation: GREEN = ground truth; ORANGE = predictions; inspect for real causes

cases.manual_observation: The ground-truth object is a circular speed-limit 50 sign, but the model predicts stop with 0.99 confidence over the same sign.
cases.possible_causes: Hypothesis only: the model may be relying on dominant sign appearance rather than the internal digits; the image alone does not establish the cause.

cases.manual_observation: The crosswalk sign is detected correctly at 1.00 confidence, while all three annotated traffic-light objects are missed. The upper-right light is partly cropped and the two lower lights are small and dark.
cases.possible_causes: Hypothesis only: object scale, partial cropping and the appearance of pedestrian signal heads may contribute to the misses.

cases.manual_observation: The speed-limit sign and traffic light are detected, but the very small crosswalk sign is not matched; an overlapping low-confidence box is classified as speedlimit at 0.33.
cases.possible_causes: Hypothesis only: the crosswalk sign is very small and distant, which may increase localization and class ambiguity.
